instruction: Draw a horizontal straight slot centered at the origin with total outside length 30 and width 10. The straight portions are the top and bottom horizontal tangent lines from x = -10 to x = 10 at y = 5 and y = -5. Close the left end with a radius 5 semicircular arc centered at (-10, 0), and close the right end with a radius 5 semicircular arc centered at (10, 0). Do not leave any construction or helper geometry in the final sketch. Save the completed model to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
